Name: Fling
Effect: Ranged. Projectile Move. If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. The User loses its Held Item. (The Base of this Move is defined by the flung Item, at the Storyteller's discretion).
Description: The Pokémon takes their held item, uses it as a weapon and the referee is somehow OK with this. The held item remains in the field and may be recovered after the battle.
